description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2940015700293 AIR,CLEANER,INTAKE: Line 0001 Qty 26 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0088 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
